No segment is missing in any language.

The no_owl fact searched 18 files and returned no matches. Nothing owl-like or mascot-like appears in any screenshot. What the patient sees in guide-en-desktop.png and guide-en-phone.png are four anatomical panels of a head: the mastoid dressing in place, a hand untying it with a direction arrow, the healed incision line behind the ear, and a magnified inset of the incision with tape strips labelled "Check for tape". Nothing in the screenshots contradicts the fact; voice quality itself is not something a screenshot can show.

The subtitles fact reports captions on all seven segments in en, es and zh-Hans. At 1280x800 the caption bar sits under the player with the spoken word highlighted ("after" in guide-en-desktop.png, "después" in guide-es-desktop.png, "天后，" in guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png), plus a full transcript on the right. At 375x812 the transcript under the player is the caption track and highlights the current sentence in bold with a rule beside it (guide-en-phone.png, guide-es-phone.png, guide-zh-Hans-phone.png), the layout the rubric says was chosen on purpose. Type is large and legible at both widths. Two polish notes, not failures: the English caption cue breaks mid-phrase at "remove the mastoid" (the Spanish cue breaks at a comma well short of the bar's edge, so this is cue chunking rather than clipped text), and the Mandarin word highlight covers "天后，" while leaving "两" out of the highlight.

The toc fact lists seven chapters, each landing exactly on its expected start (0, 12.4, 37.44, 61.92, 77.68, 101.28, 129.36 s) with the matching chapter becoming active, and reports every chapter visible at 1280x800 in all three languages. guide-en-desktop.png, guide-es-desktop.png and guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png each show all seven titles and durations in the left rail with chapter 1 highlighted, no scrolling needed. The languages fact confirms Spanish and Mandarin each load the translated title, a per-language audio file (assets/audio/v2/es/... and .../zh-Hans/...) and a first sentence matching the expected translation, with no error status. The screenshots show the whole page turning over, not just the transcript: guide-es-desktop.png reads "Guía de recuperación del implante coclear", "Idioma", "Reproducir", "Velocidad", "Subtítulos", "TRANSCRIPCIÓN", "Imprimir la tarjeta", translated chapter titles and "LLAME PARA PEDIR AYUDA"; guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png reads "人工耳蜗术后恢复指南", "语言", "播放", "速度", "字幕", "文字稿", "打印卡片" and "打电话求助". The phone versions match. No stray English is visible on either translated page.
